title: Keep the King's Command

questions.question: Who is like the wise? And who knows the interpretation of a what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:1 (ESV): "And who knows the interpretation of a thing?"

questions.question: A man's wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:1 (ESV): "and the hardness of his face is changed."

questions.question: I say: Keep the king's command, because of God's what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:2 (ESV): "because of God's oath to him."

questions.question: For the word of the king is what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:4 (ESV): "For the word of the king is supreme,"

questions.question: Whoever keeps a command will know no evil thing, and the wise heart will know the proper time and the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:5 (ESV): "and the wise heart will know the proper time and the just way,"

questions.question: For there is a time and a way for everything, although man's trouble lies heavy on whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:6 (ESV): "although man's trouble lies heavy on him."

questions.question: No man has power to retain the spirit, or power over the day of what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:8 (ESV): "or power over the day of death."

questions.question: There is a time when man rules over man to his what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:9 (ESV): "a time when man rules over man to his hurt."

questions.question: Because the sentence against an evil deed is not executed speedily, the heart of the children of man is fully set to do what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:11 (ESV): "the heart of the children of man is fully set to do evil."

questions.question: Though a sinner does evil a hundred times and prolongs his life, yet I know that it will be well with those who do what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:12 (ESV): "yet I know that it will be well with those who fear God,"

questions.question: But it will not be well with the wicked, neither will he prolong his days like a what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:13 (ESV): "neither will he prolong his days like a shadow,"

questions.question: There is a vanity that takes place on earth, that there are righteous people to whom it happens according to the deeds of the whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:14 (ESV): "that there are righteous people to whom it happens according to the deeds of the wicked,"

questions.question: And there are wicked people to whom it happens according to the deeds of the whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:14 (ESV): "and there are wicked people to whom it happens according to the deeds of the righteous."

questions.question: And I commend joy, for man has nothing better under the sun but to eat and drink and be what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:15 (ESV): "but to eat and drink and be joyful,"

questions.question: When I applied my heart to know wisdom... then I saw all the work of God, that man cannot find out the work that is done under the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 8:17 (ESV): "that man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun."

key_verse_text: Though a sinner does evil a hundred times and prolongs his life, yet I know that it will be well with those who fear God, because they fear before him.
